name: orca
title: Orca
description: Control Orca ADE from Raycast: browse worktrees, watch what your AI agents are doing, drive terminals and open files or browser tabs.
author: cvanes

commands.name: worktrees
commands.title: Search Worktrees
commands.subtitle: Orca
commands.description: Browse Orca worktrees with live agent status and act on them.

commands.name: create-worktree
commands.title: Create Worktree
commands.subtitle: Orca
commands.description: Create an Orca worktree and optionally start an agent in it.

commands.name: terminals
commands.title: Search Terminals
commands.subtitle: Orca
commands.description: Browse live Orca terminals, read their output and send them input.

commands.name: projects
commands.title: Search Projects
commands.subtitle: Orca
commands.description: Browse the repos registered in Orca.

commands.name: add-project
commands.title: Add Project from Folder
commands.subtitle: Orca
commands.description: Register an existing folder with Orca as a project.

commands.name: clone-project
commands.title: Clone Project from GitHub
commands.subtitle: Orca
commands.description: Search GitHub, clone a repo and register it with Orca as a project.

commands.name: browser-tabs
commands.title: Search Browser Tabs
commands.subtitle: Orca
commands.description: Browse the tabs open in the Orca embedded browser.

commands.name: open-browser-tab
commands.title: Open Browser Tab
commands.subtitle: Orca
commands.description: Open a URL in the Orca embedded browser.

commands.name: open-file
commands.title: Open File in Orca
commands.subtitle: Orca
commands.description: Open a worktree file in the Orca editor.

commands.name: open-orca
commands.title: Open Orca
commands.subtitle: Orca
commands.description: Launch Orca and wait for its runtime to be reachable.

tools.name: get-orca-status
tools.title: Get Orca Status
tools.description: Check whether the Orca app is running and its runtime is reachable.

tools.name: list-projects
tools.title: List Projects
tools.description: List the repos registered in Orca with their ids, names, paths and git remotes.

tools.name: list-worktrees
tools.title: List Worktrees
tools.description: List Orca worktrees with live agent status, terminal counts and last activity. Use this to answer what the agents are doing.

tools.name: get-worktree
tools.title: Get Worktree
tools.description: Get the full details of a single Orca worktree by id or name.

tools.name: create-worktree
tools.title: Create Worktree
tools.description: Create a new Orca worktree in a project and optionally start an agent in it with a prompt.

tools.name: update-worktree
tools.title: Update Worktree
tools.description: Update the display name, comment or workspace status of an Orca worktree.

tools.name: remove-worktree
tools.title: Remove Worktree
tools.description: Remove an Orca worktree, deleting its checkout and trying to delete its branch.

tools.name: list-terminals
tools.title: List Terminals
tools.description: List the live Orca terminals with their handles, titles, agent identity and output previews.

tools.name: read-terminal
tools.title: Read Terminal
tools.description: Read the output of an Orca terminal, either the current screen or a bounded slice of the scrollback.

tools.name: create-terminal
tools.title: Create Terminal
tools.description: Create a terminal in an Orca worktree and optionally run a command in it.

tools.name: send-to-terminal
tools.title: Send to Terminal
tools.description: Send text or a prompt to a live Orca terminal, optionally interrupting whatever is running first.

tools.name: switch-to-terminal
tools.title: Switch to Terminal
tools.description: Bring Orca to the front and switch the user interface to a terminal.

tools.name: close-terminal
tools.title: Close Terminal
tools.description: Close a live Orca terminal and kill its process.

tools.name: open-file
tools.title: Open File
tools.description: Open a worktree file in the Orca editor, either as a normal editor or as a git diff.

tools.name: open-changed-files
tools.title: Open Changed Files
tools.description: Open every git-changed file of an Orca worktree in the Orca editor.

tools.name: list-browser-tabs
tools.title: List Browser Tabs
tools.description: List the tabs open in the Orca embedded browser across all worktrees.

tools.name: open-browser-tab
tools.title: Open Browser Tab
tools.description: Open a URL in a new tab of the Orca embedded browser for a worktree.

tools.name: navigate-browser-tab
tools.title: Navigate Browser Tab
tools.description: Navigate a tab of the Orca embedded browser to a URL.

tools.name: close-browser-tab
tools.title: Close Browser Tab
tools.description: Close a tab of the Orca embedded browser.

tools.name: add-project
tools.title: Add Project from Folder
tools.description: Register an existing folder with Orca as a project, optionally running git init first when the folder is not yet a git repository.

tools.name: search-github-repos
tools.title: Search GitHub Repos
tools.description: Search GitHub for repositories, or list the signed-in user's own when no query is given. Use it to turn a repo name into a clone URL before cloning.

tools.name: clone-project
tools.title: Clone Project
tools.description: Clone a git repository into a directory and register it with Orca as a project.

tools.name: list-hosts
tools.title: List Hosts
tools.description: List the hosts Orca can target: this machine, its SSH targets and any paired Orca servers.

tools.name: open-orca
tools.title: Open Orca
tools.description: Launch Orca, wait for its runtime to be reachable and bring the app to the front.

preferences.name: orcaPath
preferences.title: Orca CLI Path
preferences.description: Path to the orca binary. Falls back to the copy inside Orca.app when this path does not exist.

preferences.name: defaultAgent
preferences.title: Default Agent
preferences.description: Agent preselected when creating a worktree.

preferences.name: defaultCloneDirectory
preferences.title: Default Clone Directory
preferences.description: Parent directory preselected when cloning a project.
